description: Build tracked store links for a game launch: Google Play (UTM inside the referrer parameter), App Store (campaign token ct and provider token pt), Steam or any web page. One link per traffic source. Needs GameShipKit Pro.

provider_token.description: App Store only: your pt value from App Store Connect

sources.description: Traffic sources such as youtube, tiktok, reddit, discord, newsletter

target.description: Package name or Play URL, App Store id or URL, Steam app id or URL, or a web URL

name: store_link
title: Tracked store links
